metadata.title: Amazon Boosts Minimum Pay for U.S. Full-Time Core Operations Staff to $20/Hour - WSJ

content.text:
Amazon AMZN -0.09%decrease; down pointing triangle.com is raising the minimum starting wage for its U.S. full-time core operations employees to $20 an hour.
The e-commerce company announced the $1 per hour increase on Wednesday, alongside several new benefits like discounts on groceries.
